Topic: Modern Tantra — Organ-Speciﬁc Attacks, the Power of Havan & Ashaeiynn Ambiance
Source: Bhaiya's satsang session (video transcript, ~1hr 17min), Mool Tattva series. Purpose: Chatbot knowledge — English version.
1. ASHAEIYNN AMBIANCE — ANNOUNCEMENTS & SYSTEM CHANGES

Screening replaces aura-checking. All new entrants (even relatives of members) will now undergo screening, a diﬀer ent and deeper method: aura-checking took mentors 15–20 minutes; screening takes at least 1 hour of a mentor's full attention. "Even if our numbers stay small, eﬃciency and QUALITY will be very high." Rationale: Gurudev has given access to enormous shaktis; mentors and members must use that access fully, not hoard people while ignoring their own tattva. "Hamara kaam drishti kholna hai" — and for drishti, you must be e xcellent in every aspect; every aspect of you must carry good tattva.

From the 1st of the coming month, Ashaeiynn Ambiance (the app/system) fully begins: the old havan group is closed (unoﬃcial members r emoved). Everyone should ﬁll complete details in the app; havan access goes to every Ambiance member (new members get it automatically; old members are either already in havan or… not). Two kinds of people exist in Ashaeiynn: those working hard — on whom the r esults are coming and shaktis are working — and those who "ar e not there at all." Inactive aspirants ("mouth-showing" one-time visitors) are a burden and will gradually be eliminated. "We are very sorry for that." Shaktis' aggressiveness and power in Ambiance will be increased; the havan's shakti will work day and night on every Ambiance member. Notiﬁcations policy: videos are never pushed as notiﬁcations (secondary); anything in the app notiﬁcation is major priority — note it daily .
What Ashaeiynn guarantees (and what it never claims)

Ashaeiynn does NOT cancel tomorrow's sankat. "Whoever says your coming crisis will be averted is a liar — 'Hoihi wahi jo R am rachi rakha'" (only what Ram has written happens). The actual guarantee, when you live in the Guru's sharan: (1) you will know in advance that a crisis is coming; (2) you will know how long it will last; (3) a ﬁve-day crisis will pass in one day — e.g., a 5-day fever ﬁnishes with one or two doses of medicine. "What R am wrote will happen — but the moment you step, everything starts falling into place automatically . This I guarantee from the guru-gaddi — we speak only pramanit (pr oven) words."
Daily practice architecture (the recommended routine)

Morning havan: sankalp at 8:00; the ﬁrst 40–45 minutes are the aavahan of ghor shaktis — sit and do jaap in that window; those with oﬃce can leave af ter sankalp (or a family member may sit in your place and you pray from work — "k oi badi baat nahi"). Evening: after 9:30 the session begins — light your deepaks, sit with everyone, your sank alp is taken, do jaap or play a Mool Tattva video alongside and learn one topic before sleeping. One sitting = multiple works at once (sankalp + jaap + shaktis working + learning). Deepak + havan + jaap together → all three shaktis merge and a prakash-punj (pillar of light) forms in your home. The goal: the akhand Ram-havan jyoti reaching every member's home. Mool Tattva videos: watch them ALL — during daily jaap, play one video . "By the time you ﬁnish them, you will hold mor e than 90% knowledge of the sukshma jagat." This gyaan matches no written source — "if you ﬁnd it lif ted from anywhere, come remove us from this seat." It is Gurudev's own gyaan, and through it the third eye opens. Money is never a barrier: mantra-chanting has a slight registration fee, but whoever cannot pay may sit anyway with sankalp — "if your mind holds no paap and you truly have nothing, I guarantee you WILL see — beyond limits." (P roof cited: ﬁve ﬁrst-timers sat fr ee the previous day and all ﬁve had darshan; one later paid voluntarily af ter the experience.)

Glucose/protein analogy: paid bhog-oﬀerings ar e protein, free sitting is water — "for the one who cannot drink anything, even water is plenty — it will also give shakti." What to ask for: not drishti, not shakti — ask for BHAKTI: "Prabhu, grant me ananya bhakti." With bhakti comes TIME (people's real shortage), and with time, everything. Also pray: "open my drishti only WITH protection — an unpr otected drishti just becomes a seat for bhoot-pret." And remember: "dimaag ghoomne mein samay nahi lagta" — the mind can be spun in ﬁve minutes; only Gurudev's kripa holds it steady .
Havan sitting — the year-by-year vachan (guru-gaddi promise)

Spoken as Gurudev's direct vachan ("guru vachan Ishwaro vacha"): - 6 months of sitting in Ram's havan → the entire personality transforms, head to toe. - 2 years → the body's diseases end. - 4 years → changes begin in the kundli; yogas start forming in the awakened kundli (Gajraj yog). - 5–6 years → Gajkesari yog, and gradually Raj-yog. - 8 years → Maharaj yug forms. - 12 years → Maharaj yug across seven generations. - 14 years → "jeete ji Ram ho jaoge" — you become Ram while yet living. - Ram's yagya is sheetal (cool) — it gives no thrills/romaanch; sitting sankalpvaan (with ﬁr m resolve) is the one requirement. "Everything else is secondary — drishti is a snap of the ﬁngers for my Gurudev" (ﬁve ﬁrst-timers' drishtis opened in a single session).
The four things to clear (the Ashaeiynn formula)

1. One mantra only: JAI SIYA RAM. Ashaeiynn works on one and only one mantra — fr om Ganesh Bhagwan to Rameshwar Sarkar, from the 10 Mahavidyas to Shri Raghunath Ji, everything here is done with Jai Siya Ram. Big dhams quietly prescribe other mantras alongside Ram — beej-mantra combinations (hum, hr eem, phat etc.) sold as "gupt sadhnas" — which ar e just tamasic use of those tattvas. You need no other mantra. 2. No human guru needed — your Guru is Hanuman Ji Maharaj. 3. Clear your pitrs (Ashaeiynn is relentlessly after this). 4. Set right your Kul Devta. - Clear all four together and a shakti gathers in your home such as was never formed in your entire vansh — your K ul Devta (your home's Ram) awakens the kul-shakti; but without Gurudev it cannot channelize, and if a pitru slips in between, he seizes the whole kul-shakti.
2. THE MAIN TEACHING — HOW NEGATIVITY HAS MODERNIZED
The three types of negativity (frame)

1. Khuli (open/roaming) negativity — ﬁve kinds (as taught in the mor ning havan session). 2. Sent negativity — speciﬁcally dispatched at a person. 3. Tantra-bound negativity — sent tied thr ough black magic/tantra.
Earlier, attackers used mostly #1 and #3; the middle category (#2, direct-speciﬁc sending) was barely used. Today the middle path dominates.
Why classical TANTRA declined (~70%)

Tantra = the kriya with a visible, whole-family eﬀect : the moment it lands, the whole house erupts at once — cattle fall sick, mother, father, siblings all disturbed simultaneously; even neighbors can tell "something was done to them." "Jo bahut visible eﬀect daale, wo tantra hai." But now "tantra-detecting machines" are everywhere: go to any mandir — anyone with any shakti catches tantra ﬁrst thing. T antra is detected everywhere and cut everywhere. Even unlettered villagers have built jaap-shakti enough to cut tantra. So tantra fell ~70%. Maran kriyas (killing rites) are also far fewer than before. Bhaiya's wry note: old tantra was almost "safer" — visible, diagnosable, curable at a temple. "Ours today doesn't even get cured — because it's speciﬁc."
The NEW tantra — organ-speciﬁc attack (the kavach principle reversed)

Basis: think of Raksha Kavach / Devi Kavach paths — they pray or gan by organ ("protect my eyes… my nose… my shoulders… my heart…"), building a separate kavach on each particular organ. That organ-wise targeting is the base science. Old tantra hit the whole body/family; the new tantra attacks ONE particular organ — deliberately, precisely. Typical patterns seen today: in women, trouble concentrated in the reproductive/naveldown region; in men, strong above, "failure below the waist" — a 6-foot healthy young man with one speciﬁc dysfunction he cannot even speak about. Everything else is "ﬁrst class." The electricity analogy: old tantra = 100 units of power distributed across the whole family — the actual tar get got barely 1 extra unit. New method = a dedicated line straight to one organ — all 100 units dumped on that point. ("Like 440 volts on one hand — the hand is ﬁnished; nothing else touched.") Why it goes undetected: people still think in old categories ("is it tantra? No, the whole family is ﬁne → nothing is wr ong"). A one-organ problem doesn't alarm anyone; the person ignores it, adapts, and drifts — e xactly as designed. "You can't even tell people it's daily-daily small packets — who will you accuse every day?" Delivery upgrades: attackers now mix negativity with the ﬁve tattvas — sent with dharti (earth) tattva ("infection from the ground"), jal (water) tattva ("drank bad water"), vayu (air) tattva — pr esenting as ordinary "infections." Rising infection-type illnesses are described as partly this. The pitru piggyback: mantriks lift such shaktis and bind them WITH pitrs before sending. The sent shakti sits inside the pitru — indistinguishable fr om him, occupying one part of him.
Result: "we removed the pitru but the problem stayed" — because the rider had alr eady nested in the organ.
The most dangerous innovation — entities that "do nothing wrong"

Modern sent-shaktis have learned compliance: they arrive, sit quietly on the target organ, and begin doing JAAP themselves. Any seer looks and says: "sants are sitting on you, chanting — how auspicious!" When we ask the devtas/doots to beat and remove them — "Not allowed." Why? They have broken no rule. They chant Ram's name; they follow rules and regulations; the devtas stand behind procedure: "he is taking Ram's name — let him chant." The old formula (catch → beat → bind → dispatch to Kalyan Lok) fails on them. "The person who never does anything wrong is the most dangerous person — the wr ongdoer you can thrash and deport; what do you do with one who is perfectly compliant?" So the response is KOOTNEETI (diplomacy): shaktis now negotiate — agreements and treaties are signed: "you get the fruit of your jaap from us; stay away from this person and his party; if you're ever contracted to sit on him again, please decline." About 90 in 100 comply via treaty; ~10 egotists refuse ("mera personal garaz hai"). For the treaty-refusers, one defense remains: your own body's AGNI. If your sukshma sharir is burning like ﬁr e, no entity can sit near you — "5 minutes of sitting and it's 'ui baba, lag gayi!'" — it steps aside and waits for the day you cool down. Don't give it that day .
3. WHY EVERYONE'S AGNI IS LOW TODAY (the two-tattva deﬁciency)

Modern people lack two tattvas: VAYU (air) and AGNI (ﬁre) — physically AND astrally . Lifestyle shift: earlier generations worked sunrise-to-sunset in the sun, in dust and earth, sat by the chulha — body -agni stayed high, so organ-speciﬁc sendings simply couldn't land ("aur upar se jap kare to aap us se bhid nahi sakte"). Now we hide from the sun and live in 24hour AC — physical agni fell, and over two generations astral agni fell with it. ("Had our fathers and grandfathers preserved that agni, we wouldn't need all this — but now we do .") Who is still immune: the fauji (soldier), the hard laborer, the heavy-workout person who breaks the body daily — on them only full classical tantra can work; the new subtle kriyas fail. "On us (the soft generation), anything works." The bhog-abundance problem: earlier, bhog was occasional (special causes, bhandaras). Today every home oﬀers bhog daily (no shortage of food) — so the shakti-world is pr echarged: "they have already built, from eaten bhog, as much energy as your body holds." And the pitrs assist them from inside. Trapped from both sides.

What the entities eat: your OJ (vital luster/essence). This is why relationships aren't holding and why Siya-tattva sadhna has become necessary for every person today — the body's agni has been extinguished and its oj eaten.
The two-part defense (summary)

1. HAVAN — the rambaan (supreme remedy): - Havan's agni raises YOUR body's agni (not the entity's — it must then sit away fr om you). It builds a havan-pratipunj in the body — you burn all day; entities fear approaching ("iska taap bahut zyada hai"). This heat is needed in astral form, which physical exercise alone cannot supply. - Havan is sambandh — "e xchange of energy from this universe to another"; it rises into the upper lokas and opens the universe's dimensions. The FIRST means of building relationship with the shakti-world. - The link eﬀect: sitting in havan daily builds your link in the sukshma jagat. When any attack approaches, shaktis ﬁrst check — "is this person connected to the agni from which our own tattva comes?" — and vacate their seat on their own. (P arty-worker analogy: workers of the same party don't ﬁght each other .) - Note: Ashaeiynn keeps havan free — "we put no money in havan," so the constant emphasis is not commercial. 2. CONTINUOUS JAAP + the treaties handled by the guru's shaktis (as above).
The updating world

Just as human generations' knowledge grows, bhoot-prets' knowledge grows too — "their software updates." The sukshma jagat is huge, dynamic, and updates daily. Whoever doesn't grasp this is the greatest na-samajh. Ashaeiynn stays deliberately isolated — to k eep Gurudev's shakti and vachans uncontaminated: "the day His gyaan stops coming, we too will be left standing like the other dhams." Hence: never come to Ashaeiynn uninvited/unasked; every person's shaktis reach them at HOME — such is Gurudev's prataap. "If you must copy — copy our Gurudev; the mark et updates will keep coming." (Consistent with Sessions 5–6: copying without drishti is the astral world's trap.) Closing promise: whoever works from the heart, serves Gurudev from the heart, and learns guru-vidya — uplifts not just himself but his coming seven generations.
4. QUICK RULES SUMMARY

1. Ashaeiynn never averts written sankat — it gives for eknowledge, duration, and compression (5 days → 1 day). Distrust anyone promising cancellation of fate. 2. One mantra (Jai Siya Ram), no human guru (Hanuman Ji Maharaj), clear pitrs, set right Kul Devta — the four -fold formula for unprecedented home-shakti. 3. Old tantra: whole-family, visible, detectable, curable — now ~70% declined. New tantra: one organ, one dedicated line, all 100 units — invisible to old-style diagnosis.

4. Suspect the new tantra when ONE speciﬁc or gan/function fails persistently while "everything else is ﬁrst class" — especially r eproductive-region issues in women, below-the-waist failure in ﬁt young men, or "infections" that never r esolve. 5. "Pitru removed but problem stayed" = the rider was nested inside the pitru on that organ. Ask for the deeper cleaning. 6. Compliant entities that chant jaap cannot be beaten out — they ar e handled by treaties (90%) and by your own burning agni (the last 10%). 7. Raise agni both ways: physically (sun, sweat, hard work — the fauji is immune to subtle kriyas) and astrally (havan — the only astral agni sour ce). 8. Havan = relationship + dimensional link: shaktis recognize their own agni-connected people and vacate. Sit sankalpvaan; the rest is secondary. 9. The havan timeline vachan: 6 months personality → 2 years disease-free → 4 years kundli yogas → 8 years Maharaj yug → 12 years seven generations → 14 years "jeete ji Ram." 10. Ask Bhagwan for bhakti (not drishti/shakti) — bhakti brings time, and pr otected drishti follows. 11. Money never blocks bhakti at Ashaeiynn — sank alp does the work; the sincere poor see ﬁrst. 12. The astral world updates daily — k eep learning (Mool Tattva videos = 90% of sukshma-jagat knowledge), or be left "grinding the old chakki."
Bhaiya's Teachings — Q&A Pairs (Session 7, English)
Modern Tantra — Organ-Speciﬁc Attacks, the Power of Havan & Ashaeiynn Ambiance
User-style questions with answers grounded in Bhaiya's discourse. Greeting style: "Jai Siya Ram."

Q1. Can Ashaeiynn cancel a crisis that is coming in my life? A: Jai Siya Ram! No — and beware of anyone who claims they can: "whoever says your coming crisis will be averted is a liar — Hoihi wahi jo R am rachi rakha." What the Guru's sharan actually gives is threefold: you will know in advance that a sankat is coming; you will know how long it will last; and its duration will compress — a ﬁve-day crisis passes in one day (a 5-day fever ﬁnishes with a dose or two of medicine). What Ram wrote will happen — but the moment you step, everything starts falling into place automatically. That is the pramanit guarantee from the guru-gaddi.

Q2. What is this new type of tantra you talk about? My reports are ﬁne but one problem never goes. A: Old tantra hit the whole family visibly — everyone erupted at once, even neighbors could tell. That has declined ~70%, because "tantra-detecting machines" are everywhere now: any temple, any shakti-holder catches and cuts it. The NEW tantra attacks ONE particular organ with a dedicated line — all 100 units of ener gy dumped on a single point (like 440 volts on one hand). Typical signs: everything "ﬁrst class" e xcept one persistent speciﬁc failure — r eproductive-region trouble in women, below-the-waist failure in otherwise ﬁt young men, or "infections" that never resolve (negativity is now sent mixed with earth/water/air tattvas to look like infections). It goes undetected precisely because people still diagnose by the old whole-family standard.

Q3. We removed the pitru but my problem stayed exactly the same. Why? A: Because modern mantriks bind the sent shakti WITH a pitru before dispatching. The rider sits inside the pitru — indistinguishable fr om him, nested in the same organ. Remove the pitru and the rider remains seated. This layered case needs deeper cleaning at the organ itself — raise it with your mentor rather than concluding "removal doesn't work."

Q4. A seer said sants are sitting on me doing jaap. Isn't that a blessing? A: Careful — this is the most dangerous modern innovation. Sent entities have learned compliance: they sit quietly on the target organ and do jaap themselves. They break no rule, so the doots are "not

allowed" to beat them out — the devtas stand behind pr ocedure ("he is chanting Ram's name — let him chant"). The old catch-beat-dispatch formula fails. Such entities are handled by KOOTNEETI: treaties are signed ("take the fruit of your jaap from us; stay away from this person and his party") — about 90 in 100 comply . For the ego-driven 10 who refuse, one defense remains: your own burning agni. Get it veriﬁed rather than celebrating.

Q5. How do I protect myself from entities that "do nothing wrong"? A: Raise your body's agni until your sukshma sharir burns like ﬁr e — then no entity can sit near you: "ﬁve minutes and it's 'ui baba, lag gayi!'" — it steps aside and waits for the day you cool down. Never give it that day. The agni must be raised in BOTH forms: physically (sun, sweat, hard labor) and astrally — and the only astral source is HAVAN. Havan's agni builds a havan-pratipunj in your body that burns all day; entities fear the taap.

Q6. Why does Bhaiya insist so much on havan? What does it actually do? A: Three things — and note Ashaeiynn k eeps havan free, so the emphasis is not commercial. (1) It raises YOUR body's astral agni (not the entity's), forcing entities to sit away. (2) It is sambandh — "e xchange of energy from this universe to another"; it rises into the upper lokas and opens the universe's dimensions — the ﬁrst means of r elationship with the shakti-world. (3) It builds your LINK in the sukshma jagat: when any attack approaches, shaktis ﬁrst check "is this person connected to the agni from which our own tattva comes?" — and vacate on their own, the way work ers of the same party don't ﬁght each other .

Q7. What happens if I sit in Ram's havan for years? A: The guru-gaddi vachan, year by year: 6 months — the whole personality transfor ms head to toe. 2 years — the body's diseases end. 4 years — k undli changes begin; Gajraj yog forms. 5–6 years — Gajk esari yog, then gradually Raj-yog. 8 years — Maharaj yug. 12 years — Maharaj yug acr oss seven generations. 14 years — "jeete ji R am ho jaoge." Remember: Ram's yagya is sheetal — it gives no thrills; the one requirement is sitting sankalpvaan. "Guru vachan Ishwaro vacha."

Q8. I have no money for registration. Can I still sit? A: Yes — money never blocks bhakti at Ashaeiynn. Sit in mantra-chanting with sankalp; "if your mind holds no paap and you truly have nothing, I guarantee you WILL see — beyond limits." F ive ﬁrst-timers sat fr ee recently and all ﬁve had darshan. The glucose analogy: paid oﬀerings ar e protein, free sitting is water — and for the one who cannot drink anything, even water is plenty; it also gives shakti.

Q9. Should I ask Hanuman Ji Maharaj for drishti or shakti? A: Neither, ﬁrst. Ask for BHAK TI — "P rabhu, grant me ananya bhakti." With bhakti comes TIME (the thing people actually lack), and with time everything follows. And when you do pray about drishti, pray wisely: "open my drishti only WITH protection" — an unpr otected drishti just becomes a seat for bhoot-pret. Also remember Bhaiya's warning: "dimaag ghoomne mein samay nahi lagta" — a mind can be spun in ﬁve minutes; only Gurudev's kripa holds it steady .
Q10. Why is my generation so vulnerable when our grandparents weren't? A: Two tattvas have collapsed — vayu and agni — physically and astrally . Earlier generations worked in

the sun all day, in dust, by the chulha: body-agni stayed so high that organ-speciﬁc sendings couldn't land. Two generations of sun-avoidance and 24-hour AC dropped physical agni, and astral agni fell with it. Who is still immune? The fauji, the hard laborer, the heavy-workout person — on them only full classical tantra works; the new subtle kriyas fail. On the sof t generation, "anything works." Fix both layers: sweat physically, sit in havan astrally.

Q11. Why do entities today have so much energy? A: The bhog-abundance problem. Earlier, bhog was occasional; today every home oﬀers it daily — so the shakti-world is pr echarged: "they have already built, from eaten bhog, as much energy as your body holds." And pitrs assist them from inside — trapped fr om both sides. What do they eat from you? Your OJ — the body's vital luster. This is why relationships aren't holding, and why Siya-tattva sadhna has become necessary for everyone today.

Q12. What is Ashaeiynn Ambiance and the new screening? A: The new system: aurachecking is replaced by SCREENING — a deeper method taking at least an hour of a mentor's full attention per person, because quality matters over numbers. From the 1st of the month, Ambiance fully begins: ﬁll your details in the app; every Ambiance member gets havan access; the old havan group closes; inactive one-time visitors will gradually be eliminated. App notiﬁcations car ry only major-priority items — note them daily . Existing members not yet in havan should speak to their mentor.

Q13. What's the recommended daily routine? A: Morning: havan sankalp at 8:00; the ﬁrst 40–45 minutes are the ghor-shakti aavahan — sit and do jaap then (oﬃce-goers can leave af ter sankalp, or a family member may sit in your place). Evening: after 9:30, light your deepaks, sit with everyone, sankalp is taken — do jaap or play a Mool T attva video and learn one topic before sleeping. One sitting = sankalp + jaap + shaktis working + learning, all at once. Deepak + havan + jaap together form a prakash-punj — a pillar of light — in your home.

Q14. Do I need other mantras — beej mantras, gupt sadhnas — alongside Jai Siya Ram? A: No. Ashaeiynn works on one and only one mantra — Jai Siya R am — fr om Ganesh Bhagwan to Rameshwar Sarkar, from the 10 Mahavidyas to Shri Raghunath Ji, everything is done with it. Big establishments quietly prescribe beej-mantra combinations as "gupt sadhnas" — that is just tamasic use of those tattvas. The four-fold formula instead: one mantra (Jai Siya Ram), no human guru (Hanuman Ji Maharaj is your Guru), clear your pitrs, set right your Kul Devta — and a shakti gathers in your home such as never formed in your entire vansh.

Q15. Negative energy does jaap along with me and challenges me. What should I do? A: A real member reported exactly this in-session. Two answers: (1) havan — its agni raises Y OUR body's ﬁr e, not the entity's, forcing it to sit at a distance; (2) the sambandh-eﬀect — tr eaties bring compliant entities into "the same party," and same-party workers don't ﬁght. K eep the jaap unbroken, join the havan daily, and report the pattern to your mentor. Do not fear the challenge — fear only letting your agni cool.

Q16. Why does the sukshma jagat keep changing? Weren't the old methods enough? A: Because it updates daily — just as human knowledge gr ows generation by generation, bhootprets' knowledge grows too; "their software updates." Old machines become old; whoever keeps copying yesterday's methods stays grinding the chakki. Bhaiya's line: "if you must copy — copy our Gurudev; the market updates will keep coming." This is also why watching ALL the Mool Tattva videos matters — they car ry over 90% of sukshma-jagat knowledge, and it is Gurudev's own gyaan, found in no written source.
Bot Response Guidelines (Session 7 additions)

NEVER promise that fate/sankat can be cancelled — always give the for eknowledge + duration + compression framing. Flag anyone promising cancellation as contrary to the teaching. For persistent single-organ/single-function complaints with "everything else ﬁne": intr oduce the modern-tantra concept gently, recommend BOTH medical care AND mentor consultation — never diagnose, never r eplace doctors (especially for reproductive/sexual health issues, respond with dignity and zero shame). "Sants are doing jaap on me" reports: do not auto-validate as blessing; explain the compliantentity possibility and route to veriﬁcation. Havan questions: emphasize it is free at Ashaeiynn; teach the three functions (agni, sambandh, link) and the year-wise vachan — but pr esent the vachan as the guru-gaddi's promise, in Bhaiya's words. Encourage physical agni too (sun, exercise) alongside astral (havan) — a rar e body-positive teaching; use it. Redirect requests for beej mantras/gupt sadhnas to the one-mantra rule (consistent with Session 1's ek-tattva teaching). When users ask what to pray for: bhakti ﬁrst, pr otected drishti second — never raw shakti. Spelling note: the institute's name is written "Ashaeiynn" — use this spelling consistently in all responses. Useful quotable lines: "Hoihi wahi jo Ram rachi rakha — but the moment you step, everything falls into place", "The one who never does anything wrong is the most dangerous", "Ui baba, lag gayi!", "Same-party workers don't ﬁght", "Their sof tware updates too", "Jeete ji Ram ho jaoge", "Ask for bhakti — time will follow ."
